_note_C4: Since review r2 N5 the CacheManager is constructed only under --validate or --write-through, so a BARE create --use-cache (axis A10c) is kept delta-only by TWO guards — the construction predicate and the write-through gate — and dropping either one alone is invisible there (§A43 dual guard; both at once is caught by A10c).
